import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import re
from collections import Counter


def task_func(mystrings, text):
    def _is_non_string_iterable(obj):
        return obj is not None and not isinstance(obj, str) and hasattr(obj, "__iter__")

    # Choose the most likely data source
    if _is_non_string_iterable(mystrings):
        items = list(mystrings)
    elif isinstance(text, str) and text.strip():
        items = re.findall(r"\S+", text)
    elif isinstance(mystrings, str) and mystrings.strip():
        items = re.findall(r"\S+", mystrings)
    else:
        raise ValueError("Input text is empty")

    normalized = []
    for item in items:
        s = str(item).strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        normalized.append(re.sub(r"\s+", "_", s.lower()))

    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError("Input text is empty")

    counts = Counter(normalized)
    unique_words = list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))
    frequencies = [counts[word] for word in unique_words]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    x = np.arange(len(unique_words))
    ax.bar(x, frequencies, color="steelblue")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(unique_words, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_xlabel("Words")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.set_title("Word Frequency")
    fig.tight_layout()

    return ax
